PROGRESS (2026-11-03): piece 2 built: ThemeControls variant=bar is mounted as a compact bar floated over the preview in both editor skins (shell.tsx, editor.css, kit editor-shell.css), calling the same handlers as the Theme tab; it draws only for a theme that declares dials beyond the legacy four, so nothing changes in any editor today. Still open: piece 1, the centered header, which needs a header design the handoff does not ship.

Piece 1 built 2026-11-09: centered is a stored header option (SITE_LOOK_OPTIONS.header, dials.ts no longer holds it back) and components/sites/site-look-css.ts draws it on the house header from 940px up (name centred, menu centred beneath, button right); under 940px the stacked phone header stays, because a phone cannot centre a name between two buttons without one covering the other (the 2026-11-09 draft showed that overlap at 390). Owner approved the draft 2026-11-09 18:28Z. Rendered through the real SiteChrome on New World at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920, 2000: no new overflow.
